correctness.rationale: For H=A+(d mod 2)I, the commuting cube coordinate flips imply H²=0 and a two-shore block calculation proves rank H=2^(d-1). A nonzero column/row and H²=0 imply that K=H+e_u e_v^T has rank r+1. Direct multiplication gives rank K²=2 and K⁴=εK² with ε=1 exactly for adjacent endpoints; K³ has rank 1 or 2 accordingly. These ranks give all four claimed Jordan forms over any characteristic-two field, and F=K+(d mod 2)I. Fixed-space and Fitting dimension counts prove the stated exact primitive periods, cumulative first-entry counts and equal basins. Two standalone scripts actually passed 27 matrix-rank and 14 exhaustive trajectory cases, including F4; finite checks alone do not prove the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The natural operation of toggling a single ordered regulation arc on an otherwise symmetric Boolean cube creates a genuine four-regime temporal bifurcation controlled by parity and adjacency only. Complete exact Jordan and orbit/basin distributions for every dimension and finite characteristic-two field reveal large differences from both the unedited and bidirectionally edited cube, including four-step extinction versus wholly recurrent four-cycles. The result is a complete motivated intervention-sensitivity classification, not an isolated rank computation or an arbitrary parameter slice.
